title: BalanceFormatter
description: Formats balances (1.2k, 3.4m) + leaderboard placeholders (Top & Player Rank)
body:
# BalanceFormatter

**Make your economy readable. Clean. Compact. Professional.**

BalanceFormatter automatically formats large amounts of money into compact values like `1.2k`, `5.4m`, or `2b`, and also provides a leaderboard system via PlaceholderAPI.

Perfect for scoreboards, holograms, GUIs, and chat.

---

## Features

* Automatic balance formatting  
  `105345 → 105k`  
  `11353083 → 11.4m`

* Top balance leaderboard  
  `%balanceformatter_balance_top_1%`  
  `%balanceformatter_balance_top_1_name%`

* Your own ranking position  
  `%balanceformatter_balance_position%`

* Vault support  

* PlaceholderAPI integration  

* Fully configurable (suffixes, decimal format, comma/dot)  

* Automatic updates  

* Reload command  

---

## Requirements

* Paper / Spigot 1.21+  
* Vault  
* Economy plugin (e.g. EssentialsX)  
* PlaceholderAPI  

---

## Installation

1. Download the plugin  
2. Place it in /plugins/  
3. Start your server  
4. Done  

---

## Placeholders

### Your Balance

%balanceformatter_balance%  
%balanceformatter_balance_raw%  
%balanceformatter_balance_position%

### Leaderboard

%balanceformatter_balance_top_1%  
%balanceformatter_balance_top_1_name%

%balanceformatter_balance_top_2%  
%balanceformatter_balance_top_2_name%

---

## Example

#1 Steve - 12.5m  
#2 Alex - 9.8m  
#3 Notch - 7.2m  

---

## Config

format:
  suffixes:
    thousand: "k"
    million: "m"
    billion: "b"

  decimal-comma: true

---

## Command

/balanceformatter reload

---

## Performance

* Leaderboard is cached  
* Player position is calculated dynamically  
* Fully optimized for regular servers  

---

## Use Cases

* Scoreboards  
* TAB  
* Holograms  
* DeluxeMenus  
* Chat formatting  

---

## Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature requests, feel free to reach out.
